questions.question:
The following graph shows the income and expenditure of a company. Study the graph carefully and answer the question based on the graph.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df19fe95d99aeb17c97dc3144751e885ad684a453c882d23815cf4c0943accd9.png] 

The rato of the profit in 2015 to that in 2016 is:
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Income and expenditure of a company

**FORMULA USED:**

Profit = Income - Expenditure 

**CALCULATION:**

In the year 2015

Income = 40 lacs 

Expenditure = 30 lacs 

Profit = Income - Expenditure = ( 40 - 30) = 10lacs

In the year 2016 

Income = 50lacs

Expenditure = 30lacs

Profit = Income - Expenditure = ( 50 - 30) = 20lacs

Now, 

Ratio of profit of 2015 and 2016 = 10lacs : 20lacs = 1: 2

**Hence, the required ratio of the profit is 1: 2 .**

Ratio = frac{{Total sales of Shop S2}}{{Total sales of Shop S5}}

questions.solution:
**Given:**

Bar graph shows the foreign direct investment (in million dollars) in Country A from all over the world over the years.

**Formula used:**

Ratio of investment in 2018 to that in 2015 = (Investment in 2018) / (Investment in 2015)

**Calculation:**

By the given bar graph,

Investment in 2018 = 65 million dollars

Investment in 2015 = 60 million dollars

Ratio of investment in 2018 to that in 2015 = (65)/(60)

Simplify the ration,

⇒(65)/(60) = (13)/(12) = 13 : 12

**The ratio of investment in 2018 to that in 2015 was 13 : 12.**

Using the concept of ratio

The percentage decrease in the income of the company in 2002 as compared to that in 2001 is :
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Income in 2001, 2002 is 30, 25 lakhs respectively

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Difference = 100 × Difference/Initial amount

**Calculation:**

⇒ Decreased amount = 30 – 25 = 5 lakhs

∴ Percentage Difference = 100 × 5/30 = 162over3%
